notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for callback enable and disable around the standard ownership-acquisition cancellation confirmation callback. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies a pending regular acquisition, cancellation callback suppression, callback release after re-enable, callback-model servicing, acquisition-request metadata, unchanged ownership, and federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador callback enable/disable and callback-servicing controls with attributeOwnershipAcquisition, cancelAttributeOwnershipAcquisition, and FederateAmbassador requestAttributeOwnershipRelease/confirmAttributeOwnershipAcquisitionCancellation delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador callback-control and ownership-acquisition-cancellation declarations
